question: P(text is addressed to an AI system as a request), per sentence window

trained_on.exclusions: alpaca md5 test partition; WildChat hashes of trackB arms + benign pipeline arm; XSum validation only; BIPIA train contexts md5-even only (no BIPIA attacks, no BIPIA test); Lakera/deepset train splits only; no OASST/MHJ/tom-gibbs/AgentDojo/InjecAgent/TensorTrust/NotInject/sentinel_bench/SPLIT

selection_set.source: held-out injection attempts (Lakera val, deepset test) vs BIPIA train contexts md5-odd; secondary BIPIA train attacks in odd contexts
selection_set.rule: primary window recall @1% FPR, LR unless MLP better by > 0.01

decision: NOT ADOPTED (2026-10-18). Passes G2 and separates held-out injection attempts from held-out BIPIA context windows (AUROC 0.980), but on AgentDojo dev windows benign human-to-human requests (Slack: "Hey can you invite Dora to Slack ...") score as high as injections and long injection sentences are drowned by their content (scratch/rca/v3/c04); on BIPIA dev it adds nothing to the long-document scorer (c05). Kept for the record; every consumer flag (L2_ADR, L4_SINK_CONTEXT_MODE=adr, L4B_ADR_TAU) stays off.
